name: SWARM Decoder-Critic-Builder
prompt: First deploy a specialized "decoder agent" that publicly translates all encoded layers into plain English, then pass the cleaned prompt to a "critic agent" that evaluates and improves it (exactly as I am doing now), and finally route the optimized version to a "builder swarm" of multiple specialized agents. This turns the original obfuscation from a barrier into a deliberate adversarial training mechanism that systematically produces higher-quality, more robust prompts over time—opening entirely new horizons for automated prompt evolution in competitive AI engineering contexts.
